newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P gives Swedish Match K-1 rating on CP programme.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives Swedish Match K-1 rating on CP programme.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned a K-1 rating to Swedish Match AB's two billion crown Swedish commercial paper programme.
S&P said in a statement that it affirmed an A- long-term and an A-2 short-term corporate credit rating with a stable outlook.

"The ratings reflect Swedish Match's broad product portfolio and geographic spread in its core tobacco products businesses in conjunction with a conservative balance sheet and a currently near risk-free financial profile," S&P said.
"Its broad mix of businesses and geographic coverage help offset the fact it is small relative to most major global tobacco companies," S&P said.
